title: Leading the plan selection rebuild
summary: I led a team of India developers in rewriting the exchange's plan selection on a layered data design, and presented the demo. The US head of development called it simply amazing.
what_would_have_happened: Plan selection stayed slow and tangled, with every change risky.
the_call: Rebuild on layers: a data layer, business entities separated from the CRM system, and proper logging and messaging.
what_i_did: Set the layered approach, pulled the team's before-and-after measurements into one deck and presented the demo to US leadership.
what_changed: The US head of development praised its speed, maintainability, extensibility and logging, and held it up to the organization as quality delivered in a short time.

quotes.text: My reaction in one sentence is “it is simply amazing what you guys have done”
quotes.role: US head of software development, Exeter Group

quotes.text: So I appreciate the challenge you had taken on and shown to the rest of the organization what we can accomplish in a short timeframe with high quality.
quotes.role: US head of software development, Exeter Group
